title: QwenLM/qwen-code
lede: Qwen Code is the Qwen team's open-source coding agent for the terminal, with editor, desktop, web and chat front ends and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Qwen APIs or local models.

points: Ships a full agent harness: subagents, experimental Agent Teams, auto-memory, skills, hooks, MCP servers, Plan Mode and sandboxed execution.
Agent Arena runs one task on several models in separate Git worktrees so you can compare the results and merge the best.
Providers can be switched mid-session, including local models served through Ollama or vLLM.
Daemon mode serves a web shell and an HTTP plus SSE API; it listens on loopback without auth by default, so the README advises a token on shared hosts.
The README reports 76.4% to 77.8% on SWE-bench Verified across seven versions on Qwen 3.7 Max; the project started from Gemini CLI v0.8.2.
